title: Limit and squared tail bound for a geometrically Cauchy sequence with ratio q ≤ 1/4
statement: Let X be a complete metric space (a type X with MetricSpace X and CompleteSpace X), let (v_j)_{j∈ℕ} be a sequence in X, and let a, q ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ q ≤ 1/4 such that dist(v_j, v_{j+1})² ≤ a·q^j for every j ∈ ℕ. Then there is w ∈ X such that v_j → w as j → ∞ and dist(v_j, w)² ≤ 4·a·q^j for every j ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] (v : ℕ → X) (a q : ℝ), 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ j : ℕ, dist (v j) (v (j + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ a * q ^ j) → ∃ w : X, Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 w) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, dist (v j) w ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * q ^ j
